Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Food and Drug Administration licenses HTLV III test amid doubts of its accuracy 2. LAMBDA Defense fights HTLVIII test, may sue Food and Drug Administration for unacceptably high false positive rates COMMERCIAL: "Lust in the Dust" 3. Mariposa Foundation's Bruce Vogler discovers spermicide that eliminates HTLVIII on contact 4. Update on Supreme Court cases, National Gay Task Force Versus Oklahoma City schools 5. Interview with Tom Stoddard Legislative Director of New York Civil Liberties Union, discusses gay civil rights and Supreme Court cases COMMERCIAL: "The Connection," gay and lesbian newspaper 6. Future of gay civil rights 7. Anti-gay violence/harassment in Texas COMMERCIAL: National Fund for Human Dignity with actor Mike Farrell 8. Minneapolis gym owner closes his business rather than abide by city's gay ordinances 9. Zelda Rubinstein works for Los Angeles AIDS education group, appears on posters and ads, includes clip from "Poltergeist" COMMERCIAL: Disc-o-rama, NY video and music store 10. Sports 11. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Christopher Collins, Cooperating Attorney with LAMBDA Legal Defense and Education Fund, returns and discusses HTLVIII test 12. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Media reports/current events/culture including Sammy Davis Junior clip and CBS HTVLIII coverage COMMERCIAL: "Lust in the Dust" 2. Restaurant review COMMERCIAL: "Manscape," a gay magazine 3. Sybil Bruncheon
